messages:
sam: FYI our samplekit onboarding run is showing duplicated side-effects when the client hits a 429 during token refresh. Repro steps below. 

julia: ugh. can you paste the tiny log snippet? :eyes:

sam: sure — the flow is: app sends request -> token refresh happens -> upstream returns 429 -> client retries without idempotency key -> duplicate webhook fired. log: 
```
2026-03-22T14:02:10Z INFO samplekit request id=abc123 status=401 refresh-start
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z WARN oauth token-refresh id=abc123 failed=rate_limited 429
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO samplekit retry attempt=1 id=abc123
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO webhook send id=abc123 status=200
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z INFO samplekit retry attempt=2 id=abc123
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z INFO webhook send id=abc123 status=200
```

ben: looks like the client retries right away on 429s from the auth endpoint. Are we using any jitter/backoff?

maria: samplekit currently has a simple linear backoff: sleep = 500ms * attempt. no jitter, no idempotency headers on the webhook path.

sam: that explains it. duplicates happen because refresh is retried while the orig request is also being processed. we should either: (1) ensure idempotency-key header on outgoing webhook OR (2) add full jitter + hold the retry until refresh completes.

julia: prefer both. idempotency is the safety net; jitter reduces load amplification.

ben: quick patch idea for jitter: exponential with full jitter per AWS docs: 
```
base=0.1 # seconds
sleep = rand(0, base * 2**attempt)
```

maria: implementation note — the SDK's Node samplekit lib currently exposes retry config like { retries, baseMs } but not a jitter strategy. adding an enum for jitter: [none, fixed, full] would be backwards compatible.

sam: can we add a tiny middleware that injects an Idempotency-Key for webhook sends when the webhook payload contains `operation_id`? sampleapps can opt-out.

julia: yes. code sketch: 
```
if (!headers['Idempotency-Key'] && payload.operation_id) {
  headers['Idempotency-Key'] = payload.operation_id
}
```

ben: also add telemetry: emit metric samplekit.retry.duplicate_attempts when we detect same operation_id sent twice within 5s. will help QA.

qa-bot: automated test suggestion: run the race harness 1000x with artificial 429 on token refresh and assert webhook endpoint receives at most one call per operation_id.

maria: assigning: i'll do the jitter + retry enum change in the SDK (PR target: tomorrow). sam you want to own idempotency middleware + webhook opt-in?

sam: yep, i'll open a tiny PR with the middleware and an e2e test harness. will add the curl repro for QA: 
```
# repro flow
curl -X POST https://local.samplekit/run -H "Authorization: Bearer expired" -d '{"operation_id":"op-789"}'
# then on auth mock return 429 for first refresh attempt
```

julia: thanks. long-term: we should update onboarding docs to call out recommended defaults: full jitter + idempotency by default for outgoing side-effects. small blurb in samplekit README.

ben: +1. one more thought — for Dedicated customers we might expose a server-side dedupe if they opt-in (idempotency service) so SDK can be simpler. not blocking this fix.

sam: cool. I'll post PR links here when ready. low-risk patch, but should prevent duplicated side-effects in onboarding which has caused a couple of support tickets. :thumbsup:

maria: noted, will add the metric and a short changelog entry.

julia: moving to close once both PRs merged and QA harness passes. :white_check_mark:
